objective: Independently verify the Milestone 1 movement prototype at commit f8da3ab: rerun the gates, inspect the diff against the base commit, and judge the gate check in a browser (movement, animation state following actual movement, collisions, screenshots of walk and run from side and front).

projectContext.query: 3D playable game avatar locomotion animation canvas hero transition talking avatar gestures projects skills contact

acceptanceCriteria: npm run lint, npm test and npm run build were each run by QA in the worktree on Node 22 with exit code 0, and the recorded output tails match the claims in the game-dev report (65 tests in 5 files; / route First Load JS unchanged from the 125 kB baseline).

The diff from the base commit to HEAD was inspected: no file on the design section 9 do-not-touch list changed, TalkingAvatar.tsx changes match design section 3.1 minimal M1 scope, and the hero behavior (talk button, gestures list, status line) is preserved in code.

In a browser against the running dev server, Play enters the test arena and WASD, Shift run, Space jump, camera drag and R recenter work; walking into the wall shows the idle or walk pose rather than a full-speed run; the 0.2 m step is climbed and the 0.35 m step blocks; the 30 degree ramp is climbed and the 45 degree ramp blocks; falling into the pit respawns at spawn; Exit restores the hero with page scroll and the Play button focused.

Screenshots of the avatar walking and running from the side and from behind are captured and assessed for the spec section 6 acceptance: no sideways running, no stretched limbs, no pose snapping to an unanimated pose, and foot sliding judged as acceptable, noticeable, or severe, each with the screenshot filename as evidence.

The measured walk and run speeds (1.6 and 3.8 m per second) and the R1 decision are judged against spec section 5 defaults (2.2 and 4.8) and the verdict states whether the slower values are acceptable for the prototype or must change, as a finding with evidence.

The gltf clip files public/game/clips/walk.glb and run.glb load without console errors and the animation mixer does not stall (no frozen pose after 10 seconds of walking), confirmed in the browser console and by screenshots at two different times.
Every finding is reported with file, line, severity, trigger, consequence, evidence and rule, and the verdict is approved only if every criterion above passed.
constraints: Work only inside the isolated worktree path supplied in the delegation prompt; scope every command to it; do not edit implementation files.
The dev server is already running on the URL given in the delegation prompt; do not start another on port 3000, which belongs to an unrelated project.
Browser evidence is supplementary to the Bash-run gates; headless Chromium with software GL is not a performance measurement and must not be reported as one.
Copy every acceptanceCriteria string verbatim into the report criteria array.
verdict must be approved or rejected.
